method: Horizontal triangle-plane intersection of only indexed active-render triangles, preserving original object, submesh and triangle ordinal. No AABB or convex hull contour. Disconnected facade bays remain disconnected.
authority_limits: Candidate actual source-model surfaces, not measured building floor authority. Root chooses surface semantics and floor edits.
South low vertical facade and south outward sloped band are distinct physical traces; do not combine them into one contour.
Material name/queue alone does not prove glass versus wall. Named fixed_upper_glazing is explicit; other labels are geometric candidates.
Merged polyline vertices are quantized to 0.00001 MODEL only for joining triangle-diagonal cuts; exact unrounded section segments remain available.
